title: Interior and Aftermath
author: Zephyrine Iversen
blurb: Zephyrine Almeida, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
